data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 6104 reported a gross prior year reserve release of $18.505 million in 2021, representing a 10.26% release of its opening gross claims outstanding. This favorable development was primarily driven by prior-year catastrophe reserve releases, particularly related to Typhoons Faxai, Hagibis, Jebi, California wildfires, and Hurricane Dorian from the 2019 account, as well as the impact of COVID-19 exposures from both 2019 and 2020 accounts. The syndicate's 2021 profit was attributed to these prior-year releases.
raw_causal_phrases: prior-year catastrophe reserve releases, particularly Typhoons Faxai, Hagibis and Jebi and California wildfires
2019 account was impacted by Covid-19 through potential exposure to reinsurance of business interruption insurance
2020 account was also exposed to Covid-19 through potential exposure to reinsurance of business interruption insurance
data.data_quality_notes: The claims development triangle on page 53 shows a different prior year development figure (-6.374 $m) compared to the explicit 'Over-provision in respect of prior claims and claim adjustment expenses' (-18.505 $m) in the Technical Provisions note. The explicit note is used as the primary source. The discrepancy might be due to the nature of the 'Pure underwriting year' table or the impact of Reinsurance to Close (RITC) transactions which are a significant part of Syndicate 6104's business model.
